beatNote: Doc 07 writes "(He does. At length. It is genuinely moving the first time.)" and "(He looks at his hands. Then tells the story again.)" as DIRECTIONS, not speech. check-content-schema's `beat` carries a direction into the data and lists it every run as unbuilt, which is the honest state: the option exists, the document says what happens, and nobody has written the words he says because the joke is that they are the same words either way.
exitNote: From doc 04's UNIVERSAL EXIT LINES pool. "Thank you. This has been clarifying." is marked available only when it has not been, and a man telling you the same story twice has clarified nothing, so it is his.
